About.title: About
About.intro: This application was built as a graded assignment for <link>RS School</link> — a free online JavaScript and Frontend development course. The goal was to create a full-featured Swagger/OpenAPI editor and REST client with authentication, request history, and schema persistence.
About.courseText: <link>RS School</link> is a free community-driven learning initiative with mentorship, code reviews, and real-world assignments. This project is part of the React course.
